2607.08404.title: DrugGen 2: A disease-aware language model for enhancing drug discovery
2607.08404.paper_summary: Current computational approaches for drug design typically focus on generating molecules conditioned on specific targets or general molecular properties, often neglecting the influence of disease context on target behavior and therapeutic outcomes. To address this gap, we introduce DrugGen-2, a novel generative model that designs small molecules conditioned on both disease ontology and target protein sequences. DrugGen-2 was developed by fine-tuning a pre-trained GPT-2 model on a curated dataset of approved drugs linked to their diseases and targets, using a two-step strategy of supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning via group relative policy optimization (GRPO). This process was guided by reward functions optimizing for chemical validity, novelty, diversity, and high predicted binding affinity. When evaluated on five protein targets relevant to diabetic nephropathy, DrugGen-2 significantly outperformed baseline models (DrugGPT and DrugGen). It demonstrated a superior capacity to generate unique molecules, exhibited greater structural similarity to approved drugs, and achieved improved predicted binding affinities across all targets. Molecular docking analyses further supported these findings, identifying candidate ligands with strong binding potential, including compounds with predicted affinities (-9.917, -9.485, and -9.367) exceeding those of reference drugs such as enalapril for angiotensin-converting enzyme (-8.283). By integrating disease-specific context into molecular generation, DrugGen-2 advances AI-assisted drug discovery, offering a powerful tool for de novo design and drug repurposing that accounts for the complex interplay between diseases and molecular targets.
2607.08404.paper_summary_zh: 目前的藥物設計計算方法通常專注於生成以特定目標或一般分子特性為條件的分子，往往忽略了疾病背景對目標行為和治療結果的影響。為了解決這一空白，我們介紹了DrugGen-2，一種新穎的生成模型，設計以疾病本體論和目標蛋白序列為條件的小分子。DrugGen-2是通過對一個與其疾病和目標相關的批准藥物的精選數據集進行微調的預訓練GPT-2模型開發的，使用了先監督微調再通過群體相對策略優化（GRPO）進行強化學習的兩步策略。這一過程受到獎勵函數的指導，優化化學有效性、新穎性、多樣性和高預測結合親和力。在對五個與糖尿病腎病相關的蛋白目標進行評估時，DrugGen-2顯著超越了基準模型（DrugGPT和DrugGen）。它展示了生成獨特分子的卓越能力，表現出與批准藥物更大的結構相似性，並在所有目標上實現了改進的預測結合親和力。分子對接分析進一步支持了這些發現，識別出具有強結合潛力的候選配體，包括預測親和力超過參考藥物如恩拉普利（-8.283）的化合物（-9.917、-9.485和-9.367）。通過將疾病特定背景整合到分子生成中，DrugGen-2推進了AI輔助的藥物發現，提供了一個強大的工具，用於考慮疾病與分子目標之間複雜相互作用的de novo設計和藥物重定位。
